output: Hypothesis: The first principal component (PC1) of the forms of capital during the Middle Neolithic (3400-3000 BCE) is significantly higher compared to the Younger Neolithic (2900-2300 BCE), indicating a shift in the types or quantities of capital forms during these periods. This difference is statistically significant (t-statistic = 5.26, p-value = 0.00037), suggesting changes in societal organization, resource use, or technological development.
